name: Erayobi
source:
[i]"They say that life is full of extraordinary possibilities. But extraordinary things don't happen to ordinary people."[/i]

Shana Masako is your typical high school girl—she watches anime, reads manga, plays mobile games, and hasn't a clue what to do with her life. There's just one thing unusual about her: she's cursed by a fox that enjoys playing tricks on her. So, when she runs into the handsome Inato Fudami one morning, it's a far cry from the life-changing encounter she's read of in shoujo manga. 

With the help of a disgruntled transfer student, a kindly childhood friend, and a fox that doesn't exist, explore the dreams of disillusioned youth and navigate the boundary of expectation and reality in this school life otome.

[From [url=https://seven-tailed-fox.itch.io/erayobi]Itch.io[/url]]
